checks.area: Remaining reproducible cases for the conductor

cases.procedure: Run the recorded Vitest command in an authorized synthetic environment where Node can resolve its entry point. Record actual test results.

Create a 10-slot request with 11 synthetic applicants. Reserve nine slots, accept one, then attempt two additional selections at the current revision. Expect rejection with unchanged state. Select one instead and verify ten distinct active slots.

With A pending and queue [B,C], separately exercise accept-before-decline and decline-before-accept. Retry the winning response. Expect both answers to report the saved status, one revision increment, and at most one promotion.

With A pending and queue [B,C] at revision r, exercise both commit orders between owner reorder [C,B] and A's accept, then repeat with decline. Response-first must reject the save using r. Save-first decline must promote C.

In a conductor-owned test copy, inject failure after staging decline but before promotion, and after creating the first offer of a multi-offer selection. Verify unchanged offers, queue, request and revision; remove the fault and retry once. The packet's existing rollback test aborts after a completed nested promotion.

Using synthetic sessions at desktop and narrow widths, reorder boundary backups by keyboard, induce an ordinary failed save and a stale revision, then cancel and confirm decline. Verify retained editable choices, required refresh, rank announcements and result focus.
